# scamp_ssh_key (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing SSH key by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the SSH key to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the key was created.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the key.
- `has_private_key` (Boolean) Whether the server stores the private key.
- `key_name` (String) Name of the SSH key.
- `key_type` (String) Type of SSH key (ed25519, rsa, etc.).
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format.
